sourceEnumerationRule: All visible pitched notehead centers in x=[250,1050) on all four staves of first system, three fixed training images: 26,68b,89. Exclude rests; retain ambiguous shape/fill as unknown. Do not use OMR head detections for source enumeration.
reviewer: Single AI visual inspection; not independent human source certification
annotationMethod: Direct literal shape/fill and head center position from source-only 2x cards with original-x ruler. Staff positions are observed, not pitch/key-derived head labels.
centerRefinement: Before graph comparison, bounded source-pixel x extent around visually observed head position: threshold<160, y +/-7; exclude detected staff-line bands +/-2.2px; search x +/-16; accept width8..24 and shift<=7px. No OMR notehead detections or source shape/fill used. Remaining coordinates visually checked.
scope: Exploratory retained-graph notehead localization and fill recognition, not exported pitch/rhythm or end-to-end recall
matching: One-to-one nearest head center in original pixel frame. Primary Euclidean distance <=0.5 detected staff interline, sensitivity 0.35 and 0.75. Detection graph and chord membership reported separately.
confounding: Stratify by observed fill and source image; three scans from one book/style; notation/layout/staff position and head density may confound shape association. No causal claim.

postMatchVisualAdjudications.reason: Source/graph overlay shows this head on the same printed square; original visual x anchor lies at the right edge instead of the center. Original annotation and automatic matching results are preserved. Post-match visual adjudication, not blinded source annotation.
